projects.name: Compound First
projects.tagline: A strength coach's operating system — consultation to printed plan
projects.description: A solo strength coach's operating system. Live consultation onboarding builds a red/watch/right assessment in real time as the coach types; a rule-based generator turns the intake into a personalised training + nutrition plan, rendered as a pixel-faithful 12-page print document. Client tracking (sessions, weigh-ins, check-ins) feeds an auto-flagged attention queue, with WhatsApp-native plan delivery and reminders.
projects.descriptionHtml:
A solo strength coach's operating system — from consultation call to printed plan.
  • Live assessment engine — consultation answers classify into red / watch / doing-right flags as they're typed; coach can edit any flag inline, and the curated assessment becomes the client report.
  • One plan contract — a single Zod-validated plan object drives the deterministic generator, the editor, the share page and the Playwright PDF; the renderer is a set of fixed US-Letter page components matched to the print design.
  • Next.js App Router + Server Actions, SQLite via Prisma 7 (Postgres-ready), derived metrics computed on read.
projects.shortDesc: Consultation → live assessment → personalised plan document → tracking.

projects.descriptionHtml:

projects.name: Momentum 30
projects.tagline: A live, rules-based equity momentum book
projects.description: Ranks the Nifty 200 by blended momentum, holds the best 8 of the top-30 ranks, and rebalances monthly with a buffer so positions are not churned on noise. Each name trails a 15-day Donchian low; the whole book steps aside to cash when NIFTYBEES loses its 100-day average, and redeploys at the next rebalance. Running live with real money on a cloud VPS through the Zerodha Kite API. Backtested 2011-2026, survivorship-free and net of costs: 27.1% CAGR at a -17.0% drawdown (Calmar 0.91). The wider Nifty-250 variant reaches 31.9% CAGR over 2006-2026, but pays for it with a -31.6% drawdown - which is why the live book selects from the Nifty 200.
projects.descriptionHtml: Ranks the Nifty 200 by blended momentum and holds the best 8 of the top-30, rebalanced monthly with a buffer. Each name trails a 15-day Donchian low; the book exits to cash when NIFTYBEES loses its 100-day average. Live with real money. Backtested 2011-2026 net of costs: 27.1% CAGR at a -17.0% drawdown (Calmar 0.91).
projects.shortDesc: Live momentum book — Nifty 200, 8 holdings, trailing stops and a regime gate.

projects.name: NAS — Automated Options Trading
projects.tagline: A live NIFTY/SENSEX options book that trades itself
projects.description: A fully-automated index-options selling system: every trading morning at 09:16 it sells at-the-money straddles on NIFTY and SENSEX — live, with real money, from a cloud VPS through the Zerodha Kite API. Risk is bounded in code: 10-second stop monitors, a whole-book daily stop, kill-switch and freeze controls, order-fill verification with automatic retry, and a never-carry-a-naked-leg guard. Behind it sits a ~10 GB minute-level options-data pipeline and a stage-gated backtesting discipline where most ideas are deliberately killed before real money is at stake. Includes a public explainer deck for first-time traders.
projects.descriptionHtml: A fully-automated index-options selling system — every morning at 09:16 it sells ATM straddles on NIFTY and SENSEX, live with real money on a cloud VPS via the Zerodha Kite API. Risk bounded in code: 10-second stop monitors, a whole-book daily stop, kill-switch/freeze guardrails, order-fill verification with auto-retry. Behind it: a ~10 GB minute-level options-data pipeline and a stage-gated backtesting discipline where most ideas are deliberately killed.
projects.shortDesc: Live automated NIFTY/SENSEX options book — rules in code, risk bounded, honestly backtested.

projects.name: The Morning Note
projects.tagline: Pre-market intelligence — written by AI, dispatched at 08:00 IST
projects.description: A daily 08:00 IST intelligence brief for systematic trading, built in two stages: (1) the Contabo VPS pulls live market data, holdings events, and overnight RSS into a JSON snapshot; (2) a Claude Code cloud routine narrates it with sentiment-tagged headlines and a one-liner, then posts back to the VPS for Gmail dispatch. End-to-end loop closes in three minutes; an 08:08 IST fallback on the VPS guarantees delivery if the cloud routine ever fails.
projects.descriptionHtml:
• Stage 1 — VPS builder (08:00 IST) pulls live data: yfinance, NSE F&O ban CSV, holdings calendar, and RSS feeds.
  • Stage 2 — Claude Code routine (08:02 IST) reads the JSON, writes sentiment-tagged headlines + narrative one-liner, posts back. VPS dispatches the email by 08:03.
projects.shortDesc: The Morning Note — daily quant brief written by AI, in your inbox before the bell.
